name: faf-mcp-rig
description: FAF-ready MCP server rig — minimal reference server + safe test target for FAF publish tooling.

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && rm -rf .mcpb-staging && mkdir .mcpb-staging && cp -r dist manifest.json package.json package-lock.json README.md project.faf .mcpb-staging/ && cd .mcpb-staging && npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . ../faf-mcp-rig-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").mcpb && cd .. && rm -rf .mcpb-staging
